baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction links reckoning, being left, saying, believing, and not being tested.
baseline_models.mechanism: An uncertain estimate treats voiced assent as the cause of release from interference; the closing circumstantial negation denies that bargain.

activation_trace.role: Uncertain reckoning supplies the mistaken expectation that the proposed bargain will hold.
Release and non-interference supply the exemption the speakers expect.
Audible utterance is the claimed qualifying act in the bargain.
Heart-settling assent is the inward reality that the utterance claims.
Assay of a person or material is the inspection the expectation wrongly excludes.

changed_reading.before: The ayah generally warns that believers will encounter hardship.
changed_reading.after: The ayah rejects a causal bargain in which saying a belief claim purchases release from examination.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The asserted state of faith is placed directly against the negated passive of testing.
baseline_models.mechanism: Claimed heart-security is treated as material whose quality cannot simply be left in its announced state; assay distinguishes confidence from a merely named condition.

activation_trace.role: Inner security and trust provide the claimed stable state.
Leaving a thing on its present condition supplies the static state the question refuses.
Human and metallurgical assay supplies a process that tests the quality of the claimed state.

changed_reading.before: Testing is an external misfortune added after belief.
changed_reading.after: Testing is an assay that refuses to leave claimed inner security unverified and unchanged.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A human collective says a first-person-plural formula while remaining subject to a plural passive test.
baseline_models.mechanism: The utterance can function as a circulating affiliation label; ordeal then places a publicly shared identity, not only private conviction, under load.

activation_trace.role: Visible human collectivity makes the claim a social category shared among people.
Speech circulating among people supplies the exploratory image of a public affiliation label.
Ordeal and pressure supply the load under which the public label is exposed.

changed_reading.before: Each individual privately believes and then privately suffers.
changed_reading.after: A human collective voices a shared identity whose durability becomes publicly observable under pressure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate recurrence turns assay into a disclosure process: it yields an observable distinction between a claim with solidity and its contrary.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies human assay as the initially open mechanism.
The repeated assay extends the mechanism historically and makes it an established process.
Uncovering something to a knower supplies the assay's manifest output.
Solidity and straightness turn truth from verbal accuracy into quality that withstands assay.
The contrary of truth supplies the contrasting output class.

structural_cues: 29:3 repeats the testing root and places two knowledge clauses around the truthful and the liars.
The prior peoples extend the process beyond the focus audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, uncovering, solidity, and a truth/lie contrast; I supply the arrow that trial manifests the distinction. A live alternative is that the sequence announces judgment without making trial the means of disclosure.

changed_reading.after: The test is a disclosive assay whose output is the visible difference between speech-solid truth and a false claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The second matched reckoning question identifies the first as part of an escape calculus: actors estimate that either a claim or their maneuvering can put them beyond consequence.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies a doubtful estimate of exemption.
The repeated estimate directly parallels and recalibrates the focus question.
Intentional action places deeds, not labels alone, inside the calculation.
Escaping a pursuer supplies the proposed outcome of getting beyond accountability.
Right judgment exposes the estimate as a bad assessment rather than a reliable forecast.

structural_cues: The paired openings use the same reckoning verb and parallel clauses introduced by 'that'.
Being left in 29:2 aligns with outstripping in 29:4 as two imagined exemptions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel questions, deliberate bad action, escape, and failed judgment; I infer that both questions expose one evasion logic. Alternatively, they may condemn two separate presumptions without equating their motives.

changed_reading.before: People merely hope not to suffer after belief.
changed_reading.after: People miscalculate that a declared status can exempt them from the accountability their conduct cannot outrun.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated conjunction of belief with intentional, repairing action gives the focus declaration an operational extension: the claim is carried into what one does and becomes fit for a community.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies the voiced profession whose adequacy is at issue.
Assent supplies the content claimed by the voice.
The repeated assent anchors the later sequence to the focus claim.
Purposive doing turns claimed assent into enacted conduct.
Soundness against corruption gives the enacted conduct its tested direction.
Fitness and suitability link sound deeds to entry among sound persons.

structural_cues: 29:7 and 29:9 repeat the sequence 'believed and did sound deeds'.
29:9 moves from sound acts to inclusion among sound people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated belief-action pairings and social inclusion; I infer that action operationalizes what the focus utterance claims. A live alternative is that action accompanies belief without serving as its validating test.

changed_reading.before: The contrast is simply between spoken belief and later suffering.
changed_reading.after: The claim seeks an enacted form: assay asks whether assent becomes purposive, sound conduct and a fit social identity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Testing becomes competing social pressure. Kin press toward divided allegiance, the wider human collective inflicts harm, and an opportunistic claimant reclassifies that pressure and changes speech when support appears; the question is which demand governs action from within.

activation_trace.role: The visible human collective supplies the focus population under test.
Voiced profession supplies the public allegiance claim.
Driving someone to the limit of hardship supplies coercive family pressure.
Divided divine allegiance supplies the demanded destination of that pressure.
Obedient yielding supplies the behavioral decision the pressure seeks.
The same human collective appears as both claimant class and source of trial, folding the focus subject back onto itself.
Repeated speech at pressure and support points exposes affiliation that can switch with circumstance.
The exact assent formula binds the opportunistic portrait to the focus declaration.
Harm that prevents settled ease gives social trial its felt pressure.
Making one thing into the status of another supplies the claimant's decisive misclassification.
Human ordeal names the pressure that the claimant mistakes for final punishment.
The inner source from which actions issue relocates evaluation beneath changing speech.

structural_cues: 29:8 preserves goodness to parents while refusing obedience at the point of divided allegiance.
29:10 repeats the focus sequence of people, saying, belief, and testing, then adds harm, comparison, support, and changed speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coercion, refusal, social harm, equivalence-making, switched speech, and inner sources; I infer that trial reveals which allegiance controls conduct under rival pressures. Alternatively, 29:10 may portray a special opportunist rather than define every focus test.

changed_reading.before: Testing is an unspecified event that follows conversion.
changed_reading.after: Testing is a contest of governing allegiances in which kinship, human harm, and expected support expose whether speech tracks conviction or opportunity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later active use of the same leaving root reverses its valence: people expect release without process, but a judged place is left as a visible remainder through which later people can reason.

activation_trace.role: Release supplies the untouched abandonment expected in the focus.
Leaving a trace behind supplies the productive remainder that reverses mere release.
A manifest sign identifies the remainder as evidence rather than debris.
Visibility and disclosure make the retained trace readable.
Reason that restrains ignorance supplies the later audience's use of the trace.

structural_cues: The exact leaving root recurs with an active first-person subject and an explicit sign as object.
The focus asks for persons to be left; 29:35 describes evidence left from a place after consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact root recurrence, retained sign, visibility, and reasoning; I infer a reversal from exemption to evidentiary remainder. The live alternative is ordinary lexical recurrence without a designed answer to the opening question.

changed_reading.before: To be left means only to be abandoned or released from interference.
changed_reading.after: Non-exemption can produce what is left: a visible trace by which truth becomes available to later reasoners.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same confession is later commanded, but it is supplied with objects, shared revelation, divine unity, and surrender. Speech itself is not disqualified; its treatment as a self-sufficient exemption is.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies the profession whose status is initially suspect.
Assent supplies the profession's claimed inward content.
A direct command to voice the profession rehabilitates saying as a legitimate act.
The exact assent formula binds the commanded speech to the focus wording.
Delivered revelation gives the confession explicit objects shared across interlocutors.
Divine unity fixes the confession's allegiance rather than leaving it objectless.
Yielding and handing oneself over give the voiced assent an embodied posture.

structural_cues: 29:46 uses an imperative with the same 'say: we believe' formula as the focus.
The command expands the formula through two revelation objects, one deity, and a concluding first-person-plural submission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a commanded matching formula plus specified objects and surrender; I infer that the focus criticizes exemption-by-formula rather than profession as such. Alternatively, the dialogical setting may license this speech without commenting on every profession.

changed_reading.before: Verbal profession is inherently suspect because it is verbal.
changed_reading.after: Profession is legitimate and even commanded when object-specified and yielded in posture; what fails is treating its utterance as immunity from assay.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later syntax attaches the belief root to falsehood. Therefore the bare claim in the focus is not self-authenticating: testing must disclose what actually receives the speaker's trust.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies the semantically open claim in the focus.
The same assent root takes an explicit false object, showing that assent alone does not guarantee truth.
Loss of truth and stability supplies the object in which trust can nevertheless settle.

structural_cues: 29:52 gives the belief verb an explicit object marked by the preposition.
The focus formula leaves its object unspoken inside a quoted first-person-plural claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same assent root with a false object; I infer that trial indexes the bare claim to its operative object. A live alternative is that 29:52 concerns different speakers and sharpens vocabulary without defining the focus group.

changed_reading.before: Saying 'we believe' names a condition that validates itself.
changed_reading.after: Belief is object-directed trust; assay asks what the speakers actually trust when pressure makes competing objects operative.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sea-to-land reversal and the secure-sanctuary contrast make trial alternate between distress and relief. Danger can purify allegiance, while rescue and safety can expose its relapse; physical security is not proof of faithful trust.

activation_trace.role: Trial through hardship or ease supplies a two-condition testing frame.
Exclusive separation from partnership supplies the allegiance produced under danger.
Rescue by separation marks the transition from pressure to relief.
Restored divided allegiance supplies the failure revealed after rescue.
A protected spatial sanctuary supplies concrete physical exemption from surrounding danger.
The paired security and belief occurrences place physical safety beside the question of where trust settles.
Rapid snatching outside the sanctuary supplies the surrounding condition from which safety is exceptional.

structural_cues: 29:65 pivots temporally from danger, to exclusive devotion, to rescue, to renewed partnership.
29:67 places a secure sanctuary, surrounding seizure, and belief in falsehood in one contrastive question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies danger, purification, rescue, relapse, localized safety, and surrounding seizure; I infer that both pressure and relief test fidelity. Alternatively, only danger may be the test, with relapse treated as its aftermath.

changed_reading.before: Not being left means believers must undergo adverse events.
changed_reading.after: Testing runs across changing conditions: danger may concentrate trust, while relief and protected safety reveal whether that trust endures.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence adds a formative arrow to assay: effort under hardship is followed by guidance into paths and accompaniment with good-doers, so response within testing can open the route it evaluates.

activation_trace.role: Assay supplies the opening model of evaluation.
Expending capacity under hardship supplies the tested person's active response.
Gentle direction toward way and truth supplies an outcome that develops the responder.
Traversable extended paths give guidance a processual rather than merely classificatory shape.
Doing what is good names the company in which the guided response settles.

structural_cues: The surah closes with those who strive followed by emphatic guidance into plural paths.
This response at 29:69 answers the opening passive testing question with active exertion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hardship-bearing effort followed by guidance, paths, and good-doing; I infer that testing can form the faith it discloses. A live alternative is that guidance is subsequent reward rather than a mechanism operating within trial.

changed_reading.before: Testing only sorts fixed sincere and insincere identities.
changed_reading.after: Testing is also path-forming: exertion under load becomes the site where guidance opens and claimed faith acquires direction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The focus form most naturally activates reckoning, so the sufficiency branch is form-distant; it remains anchored in the focus reckoning root and is independently awakened by two later sufficiency questions. Render it only as a secondary lexical echo, not as the base translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The reckoning root stands over the proposed adequacy of saying the belief formula.

activation_trace.role: Sufficiency and adequacy supply the exploratory possibility that the declaration is being treated as enough.
An explicit question whether something is sufficient activates the focus root's distant adequacy branch.
Sufficiency carried by divine witness relocates adequacy away from the claimant's self-account.

changed_reading.before: Do they merely reckon that they will be left?
changed_reading.after: Secondarily, do they treat their declaration as a sufficient account, when the surah relocates sufficiency to delivered evidence and witness?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The shelter/load-test mechanism is cross-domain and the packet never calls the profession a house; it remains anchored through the focus roots of security, static leaving, and assay, then receives a concrete weak-shelter mechanism in 29:41. Render it as an analogy for false reliance, never as a lexical equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Claimed security expects to remain undisturbed and unassayed.

activation_trace.role: Security and trust supply the protective state claimed by belief.
Being left in a condition supplies the wish that the claimed shelter remain undisturbed.
Assay supplies the load that reveals structural quality.
Protective alliance supplies the support on which a sheltering claim relies.
Dwelling and refuge give reliance a constructed shelter image.
Loss of strength supplies the structural failure exposed when the refuge is tested.

changed_reading.before: The declaration is a label that should secure non-interference.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the declaration can be occupied like a shelter; trial applies load and reveals whether its supporting allegiance is protective or structurally weak.

strongest_changes: The immediate sequel makes testing a disclosive assay of solidity rather than undirected suffering.
The matched reckoning question exposes an exemption and escape calculus tied to conduct.
Later exact confessions rehabilitate speech while object-directed false belief shows why speech alone cannot authenticate itself.
Sea-to-land reversal and secure-sanctuary contrast show that both danger and relief can test where trust settles.
The closing striving-to-guidance sequence makes testing potentially formative as well as classificatory.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence repeatedly split terms that the focus initially compresses: speech from enactment, belief from its object, security from fidelity, release from evidentiary remainder, and assay from both disclosure and formation.
remaining_uncertainties: The evidentiary-residue reading depends on treating the later leaving-root recurrence as an answer to the opening question rather than ordinary reuse.
The two-condition model may overextend the trial branch if relief is only aftermath rather than an active testing phase.
The commanded confession in 29:46 may be specialized to dialogue even though it corrects an anti-verbal reading of the focus.
The sufficiency and weak-shelter outliers are intentionally branch-distant and should remain qualified analogies.
